phrases.latin: Illī ubi etiam caprificus magna est. — Nōvī. — Hāc pergitō.
phrases.english: Over there, where the big wild fig is. — I know it. — Keep going this way.

phrases.latin: dextera quae Dītis magnī sub moenia tendit, hāc iter Ēlysium nōbīs
phrases.english: the right-hand road, which runs under the walls of great Dis: this way lies our road to Elysium

sources: Lewis & Short: hac
The grouped card gave no source for this word.
